meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm Owen's mother. I have about twenty minutes, Hale, so tell me why my son has a zero.
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you a question. Why does my son have a zero?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, Hale, or tell me what you have.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why did nobody call me before that zero went in? Tell me what you have, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and a written explanation of why nobody called me before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a review by the principal. The fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting never got near it, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a document, a date or a fact about the essay in front of her.
What cost ground: You answered her first question with praise, then asked her how to handle it, then appealed to being on the same team, and she treated each as a way of avoiding the question of why the zero was entered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you named none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning in one sentence that the zero was entered before you called her, then put one dated document she can check on the table.
